prompt: In my 'Deck rebuild' project, reorder the tasks so 'Pull the permit' is first, then 'Order lumber', then 'Rent the saw'.
paraphrases: Rearrange the 'Deck rebuild' project's to-dos into this order: Pull the permit, Order lumber, Rent the saw.
In Deck rebuild, move 'Pull the permit' to the top, keep 'Order lumber' second, and 'Rent the saw' last.

assertions.query: SELECT t.title AS title FROM TMTask t JOIN TMTask p ON t.project=p.uuid WHERE p.title='Deck rebuild' AND t.type=0 AND t.trashed=0 ORDER BY t."index"

pseudoScript: things reorder "$(things project 'Deck rebuild' --json | jq -r '.data.view.children.anytime.items[]|select(.title=="Pull the permit")|.uuid')" "$(things project 'Deck rebuild' --json | jq -r '.data.view.children.anytime.items[]|select(.title=="Order lumber")|.uuid')" "$(things project 'Deck rebuild' --json | jq -r '.data.view.children.anytime.items[]|select(.title=="Rent the saw")|.uuid')" --in 'Deck rebuild'
